headline: Nifty is up 11% in under three weeks on heavy foreign buying, and GIFT Nifty points to a flat start. A Nvidia shock in the US, a strong dollar and India's inflation data at 4 pm could slow the rally.

mood.label: Mixed
mood.why: Dashboard leans up (bias +31, 3 of 4 checks agree), but overnight news is mixed and swings are getting bigger. Data as of 08:46 IST.

key_points.text: FIIs (foreign investors) bought **₹12,563 crore** of shares yesterday, about 3 times their normal day.
Nvidia fell **over 10%** in late US trade on a report its board may remove the CEO; Nasdaq futures are down 0.6%.
GIFT Nifty is near **25,200–25,250**, close to Nifty's 25,255 close: a quiet open is likely.
My call: the rally is **more likely to continue** than reverse, but slower and choppier. Low-to-medium confidence.

sections.title: What changed overnight
sections.summary: Mixed night: US stocks closed strong, but US futures and the dollar turned against yesterday's rally.

points.text: US stocks rose after India shut: S&P 500 **+1.3%**, Nasdaq +1.6%. Asia is mostly up this morning (Japan and Korea +0.8%), Hong Kong −0.9%.
Nvidia's late fall pulled S&P 500 futures **−0.3%** and Nasdaq futures −0.6%. Infosys's US shares fell 2.3%; I couldn't confirm why.
Brent crude is **$91.9**, down 1% this morning after a 2% jump on Wednesday when a tanker hit a mine near Hormuz.
The dollar rose **0.7%** to a 1-year high. A strong dollar can pull foreign money out of India.

sections.title: Bounce or continuation?
sections.summary: After a big up day, continuation looks more likely than a sharp fall, with low-to-medium confidence.

points.text: FIIs are only **31% long** in index futures, so most of their bets are still on a fall. Closing those bets means more buying.
Nifty is **7.5%** above its 20-day average, very stretched. Yesterday it gave back much of a bigger opening jump.
Domestic funds sold **₹8,435 crore**, and India VIX (the fear gauge) is rising with prices, a sign of nervousness.
I'm wrong if Nifty closes below **25,000**, or FIIs turn sellers in tonight's data.

sections.title: The big picture
sections.summary: The dashboard reads bullish with medium conviction: three of four checks point up.

points.text: Nifty is above its 20, 50 and 200-day averages; the swing pattern is still a range. Trend score **+1**.
Futures rose 0.8% while open contracts fell 4.4%: bets on a fall being closed, not fresh buying. Score **+1.25**.
Option sellers defend a floor at 25,000 and a ceiling at **25,500**; put selling near 25,100–25,200 adds support. Score +1.2.
Put-call ratio (bets on a fall vs bets on a rise) fell from 1.20 to **0.98** in five days: less protection under the market. Score −1.
India VIX is 17.6, higher than **81%** of the past year, so expect bigger daily swings.

sections.title: What big investors are doing
sections.summary: Foreign investors are driving the rally while domestic funds sell into it.

points.text: FIIs have bought **₹65,735 crore** in November after two months of selling.
FII long share in index futures rose from 10.6% on 2 Nov to **31%**. A turn up from under 10% has come before past rallies.
DIIs (Indian funds) sold **₹40,504 crore** this month. If FIIs slow down, support is thinner.

sections.title: What the world is telling India
sections.summary: Cheaper oil helps India, but US rate-hike fears and a strong dollar work against it.

points.text: Brent is **14%** cheaper than a month ago on US-Iran deal hopes, lowering India's import bill.
Markets expect the US Fed to **raise** rates: 6-month US bills pay 4.38% vs the Fed's 3.88%. That makes US savings more attractive.
The rupee is firmer at **93.69** per dollar, up 1.7% in a month.

sections.title: Company results
sections.summary: Recent Nifty 50 results were solid; three more report tomorrow.

points.text: Hindalco's profit rose **59%** year on year (Strong); Tata Steel's rose 16% (In line).
No Nifty 50 company reports today. Eicher, Grasim and Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles report **13 Nov**.
Weaker US tech mood after Nvidia could weigh on Indian IT shares today.

sections.title: What could change the picture
sections.summary: Inflation today, US prices tomorrow and Nvidia's results next week are the main tests.

points.text: India CPI at **4 pm**: about 6% is expected, which would be the first breach of the RBI's upper limit since Oct 2024. Bad for banks.
US producer prices **13 Nov**, 7 pm IST: a hot number would lift Fed hike bets and the dollar.
Weekly expiry and Nvidia results **17 Nov**; monthly expiry 23 Nov; RBI policy 4 Dec.

levels.note: A close above 25,500 would mean call sellers have given up and the rally has more room; a close below 25,000 would break the floor and suggest the run is pausing.

watch.text: The open: GIFT Nifty points to a flat start.
IT shares, for any knock-on from Nvidia.
India October CPI; above 6% would hurt banks.
Evening FII/DII data: does foreign buying continue?

bottom_line: The dashboard leans bullish (bias +31, medium conviction), driven by heavy foreign buying and bets on a fall being closed. Overnight cues roughly cancel out, so the open should be quiet. I expect the rally to continue more slowly with bigger swings between about 25,000 and 25,500, with low-to-medium confidence because Nifty is very stretched. The main risks are a hot inflation number at 4 pm or FIIs turning sellers.
